READY.

All four prior issues are closed by the revised plan.md, with no new defect introduced:

- **Sole blocker (four-module load/restore fidelity)** — Fixed. Capture is now the loaded module **subset** plus device-node set (plan.md:184–186); stages are required only to carry an artifact per captured module and must not require/load/restore an absent module (plan.md:186–189); removal/load operate on "exactly the captured subset" (plan.md:191–195); both the pre-cell and recovery paths assert **module-set and device-node-set equality** against the pre-mutation snapshots, with hard recovery failure on mismatch (plan.md:195–196, 207–211).

- **Minor (a) ring-pressure filter** — Fixed. The observer now filters both `0xa06c0103`/`0xa06c0107` **before** ring output and explicitly drops the timeslice-only GPreempt filter, so unrelated controls cannot consume capacity (plan.md:114–117).

- **Minor (b) claim breadth** — Fixed. The claim is narrowed to the **tested** APPLY/DEFAULT/REPEAT/CONFLICT/RANGE statuses (plan.md:226–227), still excluding performance, quantum, verifier rejection, universal/all-constructor/all-GPU semantics, and crash recovery (plan.md:233–237).

- **Minor (c) constructor-instrumentation validation** — Fixed. Semantic patch review of the actual instrumentation placement is now an explicit hard gate alongside build + CPU tests + a **real** native numerical preflight (plan.md:216–221).

Matrix, per-cell gates, GSP join, and CPU-only status (plan.md:3–7) remain consistent with the attached sources. This is a design/plan verdict only; nothing has been built, loaded, attached, or run.
